title: Test Results Comparison and Reporting Tool — Overview and definition

body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Compares test runs across revisions and turns results into decision-ready reports. A test results comparison tool ingests results from multiple runs, aligns them by test case and DUT revision, highlights regressions and improvements, and renders executive and engineering reports. Real implementations include Allure TestOps, ReportPortal, and custom pandas/Jupyter pipelines. It applies statistical tests so a 2% shift is flagged only when it is real.
